title: fix(studio): list an order-only field change in the publish review and pin platform fields on the form canvas
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgVPwkGeZxvbHqGDhHfetYNP)_

Fixes #27516

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：发布审阅单对「只调整了字段顺序」的对象草稿，展开后列出一行「字段顺序已变更」并保留 Update 标记，不再显示「No differences detected」；Studio 表单设计器里，与平台定义完全相同的字段（实际就是 Owner）在未分组区始终排在首位，把作者字段拖到它上方会落在它下方，拖放播报也报这个位置。
- 为什么改：发布按字段顺序计算内容哈希、纯重排会真的发布新版本，但审阅单说没有差异；画布允许把字段放在 Owner 上方，刷新后平台又把 Owner 放回最前，作者的排列悄悄失效。
- 风险与回滚：只动 Studio 两处界面与一个新文案键（10 个语言包各一行）；不改元数据协议、不改服务端；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`DraftChangesPanel.tsx` 的 `fieldOrderChanged`（排除哪些平台注入列）；`ObjectFormDesigner.tsx` 的 `settlePinned` / `dropLayout`（onDragEnd 与播报共用一套落点计算）；两份新测试。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/DraftChangesPanel.fieldOrder-27516.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectFormDesigner.pinnedFields-27516.test.tsx`，预期 13 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Publish review sheet (`DraftChangesPanel`)** — `computeChangeDetail` now reports `fields.reordered` for an `object` whose two versions declare their shared fields in a different order, and the drill-in prints a `~ Field order changed` row (new key `preview.changes.fieldOrderChanged`). `isEmptyChangeDetail` counts it, so such an entry keeps its Update badge instead of the "No differences detected" glyph.
  - The order compared is the order the publish door stores. Left out on both sides: a column the platform injects while its definition is exactly the platform's (`isInjectedColumnDefinition` over `injectedSystemColumnDefs`, both from `@objectstack/spec/data`), which the `/meta` reads prepend and the draft write strips; and a column the platform injects and hides (`isStudioHiddenSystemField`, the search companion among them). Only fields both versions declare are compared; an added or removed field is already a row.
  - Gated on `type === 'object'`, the one row of the door's ordered-map table; the comment on `fieldOrderChanged` names that table as the authority.
- **Form designer canvas (`ObjectFormDesigner`)** — `settlePinned` places every shown ungrouped field whose definition, without its `group`, is the platform's own first in the ungrouped bucket, in the injection's order. It runs on the derived layout and on every drop. `onDragEnd` and the live-region `dropPlaceIn` now share one `dropLayout` (the arithmetic `dropPlaceIn` used to restate), so the place announced is the settled place committed. A pinned field moved into a section carries `group` and is the author's from then on; an edited one (a changed label) likewise. `FieldControlPreview` is untouched.
- **i18n** — `preview.changes.fieldOrderChanged` in all ten locale packs.
- Root changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Tests

- New `DraftChangesPanel.fieldOrder-27516.test.tsx` (9 cases): a pure reorder of authored fields, the array shape of `fields`, a same-order control, platform columns placed differently on the two reads (registry-backed vs overlay-backed) compare equal, an author-declared `owner_id` counts, added/removed fields are not a reorder, non-`object` types are not compared; on the panel, the row prints and the Update mark stays, with a same-order control still reading "No differences detected".
- New `ObjectFormDesigner.pinnedFields-27516.test.tsx` (4 cases), on the real `DndContext` with the band geometry of the objectui#11802 suite, and a `reload` that replays the round trip with the spec's helpers (strip what equals the platform's definition, prepend the injected columns): Condition dropped on Owner lands at 2 of 3, is announced there, and the reloaded canvas shows the same order; author reorders below Owner survive the reload; an author-changed `owner_id` keeps the place it is given; Owner moved into a section keeps its section order through the reload.
- Ablation, one leg per behaviour, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob changed, restored with `git diff HEAD` empty); app-shell tests import the source, no build in the path:

| Leg | Mutation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| review order | `reordered` forced false | 4 of 9 red (every positive case); controls green |
| canvas settle | `settlePinned` returns the layout unsettled | 1 of 4 red (the drop above Owner); the three author-order cases green, as they should be |

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ packages/app-shell/src/preview/`: 293 files, 2076 tests passed (includes the objectui#11802 announcement suite, whose drop-vs-commit control now runs through the shared `dropLayout`).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/`: 90 files, 1379 passed, 13 skipped (locale key parity included).
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`: exit 0. eslint on the four touched source/test files: 0 errors (8 warnings, all on lines this PR does not touch).

## Acceptance notes

- **Triage reading, measured.** Triage asked the review sheet to use "the same order-aware comparison publish already uses". That comparison is `canonicalize(body, 'object')` in `@objectstack/metadata-core` (its `ORDERED_MAPS` table keeps the order of an `object`'s `fields`). It cannot be imported here as is: the module imports `node:crypto` at its top, and `@object-ui/app-shell` does not depend on `@objectstack/metadata-core`. The sheet therefore restates that one row's rule, keyed on the same type, and reuses the spec's exported injection helpers rather than a second list of platform columns. The seat approved this before it was written.
- **Where `owner_id` is re-injected, measured.** The `/meta` read exits call `governServedItem`, whose `applyInjectedSystemColumns` (`@objectstack/metadata-core`) builds `fields` as the injected-but-undeclared columns followed by the declared ones; the draft write's `stripInjectedSystemColumns` removes a column whose definition equals the platform's (`isInjectedColumnDefinition`). The canvas pins exactly that set, read through the same spec helpers.
- **File surface.** The ten `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` packs (one key each) were added to the claim's file surface with the seat's approval.
- The canvas does not add a visible "pinned" marker: a field dropped above Owner lands below it and the live region names that place. A marker would need new designer copy; noted, not added.
- A sighted drag still previews the card above Owner while the pointer is there (dnd-kit's sortable preview); the drop settles it. Noted.
- Docs-driven rule (ui/AGENTS.md #2): no docs page describes the review sheet's field rows or the designer's ungrouped order; nothing to update.

## Verification

- Derived gate list (`dispatch-gates --commands`): 34 families run locally, 33 exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` exited 1 on one 15 s timeout (`check-vi-mock-inherit.test.ts`, run beside a locked vitest run); that file alone under the lock: 83/83 passed. `--ran` reconciliation: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0.
- `origin/main` merged (`a7a422a4`); it touched neither `DraftChangesPanel.tsx` nor `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`. After rebuilding the merged ui packages: the two new files, the objectui#11802 announcement suite and both locale parity suites, 69/69 passed; `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` exit 0.
- Full readings are in the report comment on #27516.
